evidencePolicy.runtime: Only uniquely named disposable Herdr sessions, fixture repositories, and isolated browser profiles; never the protected/default session or unrelated tabs.
evidencePolicy.inconclusiveRule: Use INCONCLUSIVE only after the listed attempts and escalation, retaining diagnostics and the exact missing prerequisite.

fixture.panesPerTab: At least two terminal/agent panes where supported
fixture.repositories: Two disposable repositories with changed and untracked files
fixture.browser: Owned fixture page plus pending browser feedback

matrix.productFunction: Command menu: open, search, choose, execute a command
prerequisites: Disposable session has both Spaces, active tab, and an owned terminal pane
Fixture contains at least one command with visible state change
actionVariants: Type partial query and choose result
expectedVisibleOutput: Menu is visibly anchored to active Cockpit surface
Search results narrow without losing focus
Chosen command closes menu and updates only the active target
Escape restores prior surface with no mutation
authorityEvidence: runtime DOM/accessibility tree and action log
negativeRecovery: Unknown query: show no-results state; retry with known command
Shortcut conflict: use visible affordance; if both fail capture key event and escalate
Command failure: preserve menu/session and retry once after resync
machineEvidence: command id, query, active Space/tab/pane IDs
matrix.cleanup: Close menu, restore active target, remove only disposable session resources

matrix.productFunction: Annotation overlay mode switch and pass-through browsing
prerequisites: Owned HTTP(S) fixture tab is visible
Extension is loaded in isolated profile
actionVariants: Switch modes while a draft mark exists
expectedVisibleOutput: Toolbar announces current mode
Annotate captures pointer input
Browse passes page pointer/scroll through and does not create marks
Draft marks remain attached to the same document
authorityEvidence: owned tab DOM and extension event log
negativeRecovery: Wrong/non-HTTP tab: disable action and show reason; select owned page and retry
Document navigation: mark draft stale; retain it and require explicit discard/retry
machineEvidence: tabId/documentId, mode transitions, pointer event counts, draft key
matrix.cleanup: Return fixture to Browse and close owned tab

matrix.productFunction: Freehand annotation with optional multiline comment
prerequisites: Annotate mode active on owned fixture
No pending capture blocks a new capture
actionVariants: Draw long stroke near point cap
expectedVisibleOutput: Red freehand mark follows pointer
Editor opens and accepts up to 4000 characters
Done commits visible mark and comment
Empty comment remains a valid mark
authorityEvidence: isolated fixture screenshot plus DOM snapshot
negativeRecovery: Pointer cancel: remove transient stroke only and allow retry
Point cap: retain bounded mark and record truncation
Oversize comment: reject visibly, preserve editor text for correction
matrix.consumingSurface: page overlay, capture payload, FeedbackPanel card
machineEvidence: annotation id/kind/point count/comment length, documentId, event timestamps
matrix.cleanup: Discard draft or deliver only to disposable target; remove fixture annotation state

matrix.productFunction: Element annotation with durable locator/anchor evidence
prerequisites: Fixture has stable heading, button, and source marker
Annotate mode active
expectedVisibleOutput: Selected element is visibly marked
Comment is positioned without intercepting page controls
Review resolves locator or clearly reports stale anchor
authorityEvidence: fixture DOM identity and review receipt
negativeRecovery: Removed element: mark stale and offer Review, then capture-anyway only with explicit choice
Ambiguous locator: show unresolved state and retain original locator diagnostics
machineEvidence: locator list, selected tag/role/text hash, geometry before/after, stale flag
matrix.cleanup: Restore fixture DOM and discard disposable draft

prerequisites: Owned fixture page has a bounded content region
Annotate mode active
expectedVisibleOutput: Region fill/border matches selected bounds
Comment editor targets region
Review displays region geometry and editable comment
negativeRecovery: Pointer cancel or zero-area drag: no committed mark; retry
Viewport scroll during drag: retain document coordinates or flag alignment dirty
machineEvidence: bounds x/y/width/height, viewport scroll, annotation id, alignment status
matrix.cleanup: Discard region draft and restore scroll position

matrix.productFunction: Text annotation anchored to a page point
prerequisites: Owned fixture page is visible
Annotate mode active and text affordance available
actionVariants: Place text at empty page point
expectedVisibleOutput: Text editor opens at the chosen page point
Committed text is visible and remains attached to document coordinates
Cancel creates no annotation
FeedbackPanel shows text annotation summary
authorityEvidence: owned fixture DOM and annotation draft receipt
negativeRecovery: Empty text: reject commit and retain editor
Text exceeds limit: show validation and preserve editable value
Page moves before capture: mark alignment dirty and require Review or explicit capture-anyway
matrix.consumingSurface: page overlay, capture payload, Review, FeedbackPanel
machineEvidence: annotation id/kind/text length, point coordinates, documentId, alignment status
matrix.cleanup: Cancel or discard text draft and restore fixture page

matrix.productFunction: Select, edit, review positions, and remove a mark
prerequisites: Fixture has one freehand, one element, and one region mark
expectedVisibleOutput: Selection is visibly outlined
Review identifies aligned/misaligned marks
Remove disables when nothing is selected and removes only selected mark
negativeRecovery: Moved layout: require review before capture; retry review after stable layout
Remove failure: preserve mark and capture error diagnostics
machineEvidence: mark IDs before/after, selected ID, alignmentReason, draft annotation count

matrix.productFunction: Capture visible annotated tab and save evidence
prerequisites: Selected visible owned tab/document, connected pairing, reviewed marks
No pending capture
expectedVisibleOutput: Capture button enters busy state
PNG is saved with annotation IDs
Popup shows saved status and pending count decreases
authorityEvidence: background.js visible-tab/document checks and PNG validation
negativeRecovery: Active tab changes: refuse capture with explicit reason; reselect and retry
Invalid/oversize PNG: retain draft and retry once; escalate with raw error
Pending capture exists: block second capture and offer Retry/Discard
machineEvidence: tabId/windowId/documentId, PNG width/height/bytes/hash, annotation IDs, activation generation
matrix.cleanup: Deliver or discard owned pending capture; stop isolated browser

matrix.productFunction: Popup status, tab selection, drafts, stale recovery, reconnect
prerequisites: Isolated extension popup and at least two owned tabs; pending feedback and stale draft prepared
expectedVisibleOutput: Connected/Offline and Space label are explicit
Draft list shows URL/document and annotation summaries
Discard removes only selected stale draft
Retry changes pending state to saved or visible error
authorityEvidence: runtime popup DOM and storage receipt
negativeRecovery: Popup verification failure: retain diagnostic and mark INCONCLUSIVE after two probes
Reconnect timeout: preserve drafts, retry once, then escalate with network/error log
machineEvidence: connection state, draft keys/counts, stale flags, retry attempt number, storage snapshot hash
matrix.cleanup: Clear only extension data created by disposable profile

matrix.productFunction: Files tree, file read/search, changed and untracked state
prerequisites: Two disposable repositories mounted to distinct projects
Each has tracked modification and untracked file
expectedVisibleOutput: Tree shows repository identity and status badges
Read view shows path/line mapping
Search results identify file and line
Switching project does not leak files
negativeRecovery: Missing file: show not-found and refresh action; retry after status resync
Foreign path/project: refuse and retain current selection
Large search: enforce bound and report truncation
machineEvidence: project/repository/worktree IDs, path allowlist, status counts, query/result bound, request timings
matrix.cleanup: Remove only disposable repositories and unmount workspaces

matrix.productFunction: Context document rendering and source import
prerequisites: Fixture contains Markdown, Mermaid, image, and source import references
expectedVisibleOutput: Markdown headings/code are readable
Mermaid either renders or reports bounded error
Image has stable dimensions/alt text
Imported source retains origin and revision
negativeRecovery: Malformed Mermaid/image: show localized error and retain source
Revision mismatch: mark stale and require refresh
Import timeout: retry once then retain partial context
machineEvidence: context ID, source path/revision, renderer result, payload bytes, error code
matrix.cleanup: Delete imported context artifacts created for the fixture

matrix.productFunction: Review comments: create, edit, remove, batch, and paste fallback
prerequisites: At least two changed files and three annotation/comment drafts
Source lines are initially current
expectedVisibleOutput: Draft count and file grouping are accurate
Preview shows exact comment text and line mapping
Edit/remove update only chosen draft
Submit yields per-comment acknowledgement
negativeRecovery: Stale source: mark affected comment stale and offer refresh/paste fallback
Paste rejected: retain draft and show explicit fallback
Partial submit: preserve unsent comments and per-item errors
machineEvidence: draft IDs, file revisions, line ranges, batch ID, submit outcome per item
matrix.cleanup: Discard unsent drafts and delete disposable review target

matrix.productFunction: FeedbackPanel overview of browser annotations and acknowledgement
prerequisites: Pending browser feedback exists for owned tab/document
At least one eligible and one ineligible delivery target
expectedVisibleOutput: Panel groups by source tab/document
Annotation kind/comment/target is readable
Acknowledgement removes only acknowledged item
Ineligible target remains visibly blocked
authorityEvidence: FeedbackPanel runtime DOM and acknowledgement receipt
negativeRecovery: Unknown document: retain pending item and show stale state
Acknowledge timeout: keep item pending, retry once, escalate with dispatch ID
machineEvidence: feedback IDs, source tab/document, acknowledgement IDs, eligibility reasons, pending count
matrix.cleanup: Acknowledge or discard only owned feedback and clear disposable state

matrix.productFunction: Terminal delivery to eligible/ineligible agents with acknowledgement
prerequisites: Two Spaces with multiple agents/panes; one eligible target and one ineligible target; terminal ownership is verified
actionVariants: Choose eligible agent from command menu
expectedVisibleOutput: Eligible target shows delivery acknowledgement in correct pane
Ineligible target is refused with reason
Wrong active Space cannot receive delivery
Terminal focus/ownership is restored after send
authorityEvidence: browser delivery source and dispatch receipt
negativeRecovery: Target disappears: preserve unsent item and refresh target list
Unknown dispatch outcome: query status once; if unresolved retain item and diagnostics
Ownership mismatch: refuse without sending and escalate after one resync
machineEvidence: Space/tab/pane/agent IDs, ownership token, eligibility result, dispatch ID/status, active target before/after
matrix.cleanup: Stop only disposable agents/panes and verify no delivery to protected session
